approved.reason: AdminSession must expire immediately when the Admin Screen closes, but the base SPEC defines no client-to-server close packet for the admin session.
approved.semantics: Validate OP, owner, machineId and sequence exactly like every admin packet, then invalidate the memory-only AdminSession immediately. CLOSE_REQUEST remains gameplay-session-only.

approved.reason: Pachinko is a machine family separate from the locked slot reel protocol and requires dedicated client-to-server actions instead of overloading SPACE_ACTION or reel stop packets.
approved.semantics: PACHINKO_FIRE requests one server-authoritative ball fire, PACHINKO_START acknowledges a valid start-entry event generated by the pachinko flow, and PACHINKO_PRESENTATION advances only server-validated pachinko role/presentation state. None reuse slot BET/LEVER/reel-stop semantics.

approved.reason: Nearby clients need one server-authoritative deterministic pachinko presentation event without reusing slot spin/reel packets.
approved.semantics: Server-to-client event identifies one committed pachinko kurun sequence. Clients reconstruct motion from event identity, outcome, deterministic seed and authoritative start time; coordinates are not streamed per tick.
